description: Get the chains / chain IDs supported by the Etherscan V2 API. In the hosted (proxy) deployment this returns a bundled snapshot shipped with the server, refreshed when the package is updated; in direct/stdio mode it queries the live chain-list endpoint. A chain's absence from the returned list is not proof that it lacks live support.
name: get_supported_chains

data.description: The JSON result returned by the Etherscan data tool.

title: Get Supported Chains
